# Prepared documentation contracts

These inputs are hand-authored synthetic regression data for the legacy checkout fixture.
`$source`, `$test`, and `$contract` are replaced with freshly captured evidence IDs by
the test harness. No documentation is generated by a model and no examples are executed.

Tests that exercise a `passed` or `failed` example record construct explicitly labelled
prepared provenance. Those records test validation and rendering, not real execution,
semantic truth, model quality, or production readiness.

`contract.md` is copied into the temporary source fixture before its initial scan.
The JSON files remain outside the source fixture and cannot become their own evidence.
